title: fix(console): hide the dev admin chip when email and password sign-in is off
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuSsxASUNa88cQKqk6NNZWir)_
Fixes #30420

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Console 登录页在服务端关闭邮箱+密码登录时,不再显示「Sign in as dev admin」开发管理员入口。
- 为什么改:该入口用邮箱+密码登录,密码登录关闭时服务端必然拒绝(`EMAIL_PASSWORD_DISABLED`),页面其余部分已只显示 Google 等提供方,入口是误导。
- 风险与回滚:仅 `os dev` 开发环境可见的一行渲染条件,生产从不下发 `devSeedAdmin`;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx` 中 `DevAdminRow` 的渲染条件;其次测试文件新增两例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/LoginPage.dev-admin-hint.test.tsx`,预期 12 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `LoginPage` drew the dev-seeded admin row on `devSeedAdmin` alone. It now draws it only when `/api/v1/auth/config` does not report `emailPassword.enabled: false`, the same answer `LoginForm` reads to hide the password form (`config?.emailPassword?.enabled === false`). The condition reads the `authConfig` state the "Read public auth config" effect already stores; that effect and the "Post-login orchestration" effect are unchanged.
- Changeset: `.changeset/30420-dev-admin-chip-password-off.md`, `@object-ui/console` patch.

## Tests

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/LoginPage.dev-admin-hint.test.tsx`, two new cases:

- seed + `emailPassword.enabled: false` (Google configured) → no `dev-admin-hint` row, no chip, read after the Google button appears;
- seed + `emailPassword.enabled: true` → row and chip (positive control; the existing seed-only case covers the absent key).

## Acceptance notes

- The whole row (label and chip) is hidden, not only the chip: the row exists to offer the seeded password account, which cannot sign in while password sign-in is off.
